gizmo.title: Tilmaan is-milicsi
gizmo.description: Ka codso arday inuu ka fiirsado darajo ama niyad, kuna bixi tilmaan is-hagaajin ah iyadoo lagu salaynayo jawaabta.

configure.title: Nooca gelinta
configure.description: Sida ardaygu u sheego xaaladdiisa. Labaduba waxay isticmaalaan cabbir 0 ilaa 4 (darajo: F=0, D=1, C=2, B=3, A=4; niyad: aad u liita=0 ilaa aad u wanaagsan=4).

configure.title: Su'aal
configure.description: Su'aal loogu talagalay ardayga. Ka tag madhan si loo isticmaalo qiimaha caadiga ah ee nooca gelinta.

configure.title: Tilmaamo
configure.description: Jawaab-celin lagu muujiyo kala duwanaansho jawaabo. Waxaa la isticmaalaa kala duwanaanshaha ugu horreeya ee ku habboon.
